basic_info.description: This charming 2-bedroom, 1-bath condominium checks all the boxes.  Located in a well-maintained, self-managed 4-unit building with low HOA dues, it offers 1-car garage parking, extra storage, in-building laundry, and a shared backyard ready for someone to create their own oasis. Located on a designated Slow Street, it offers the perfect blend of city energy and residential tranquility. With The Panhandle just one block away, your backyard becomes a lush green escape.  Only six blocks, the iconic Haight-Ashbury district awaits, filled with eclectic shops, cozy cafes, renowned restaurants, and buzzing nightlife. 9 blocks is Golden Gate Park! Location is hard to beat! Whether you're drawn to historic charm, local culture, or the vibrant energy of San Francisco, this home puts you right at the intersection of lifestyle and location.
